name: Disconnect during a message
description: Both directions of a truncated message: the mock dies mid-response, and the client aborts mid-request.

rules.name: Would answer a complete ABORTED request

scenarios.name: peer-closes-mid-response
scenarios.description: The mock writes only the first 40 bytes of its response and then closes. The client holds an incomplete message and must report a truncated read rather than parsing garbage.

scenarios.name: client-aborts-mid-request
scenarios.description: The client stops writing after 30 bytes and closes. The peer's decoder is left holding a partial header block, which it must discard on close without crashing.
